mentions.name: Shoehorn
mentions.description: An opinionated, simple intelligent developer platform (like Backstage) that teams configure, deploy, and update. Features include a service catalog, GitHub crawler, Kubernetes entity discovery via k8s-push-agent, Forge with molds for scaffolding and workflows (similar to Backstage templates), governance, scorecards, cloud provider resources, license management, event-based notifications, team-context awareness, scoped API keys alongside session RBAC, and a CLI plus Terraform provider. Beta targeted for end of April.
mentions.problem: Teams end up reinventing the wheel by building and maintaining their own developer portals, even when using Backstage, which was meant to prevent that.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're still building https://shoehorn.dev/: an Intelligent Developer Platform (think Backstage, but opinionated and simple). With Shoehorn, you just run the thing.
